BEHIND THIS RECOMMENDATION

A transparent simulation

This prototype explores sponsorship recognition, understanding of data use, and controls that actually change recommendations.

Implemented: a small rule-based parser, catalogue filtering and ranking, explanations from execution metadata, separate data-use settings, undo and session evidence export.

Simulated: commercial sponsorship and the shopping conversation’s limited language understanding. No live LLM, real advertiser, transaction, account or external tracking is connected.

Changing an ad setting affects future results on this page. It does not erase earlier messages or an evidence file you already downloaded. Reset clears this page’s session.
